name: slow-degradation
description: Linear latency increase 0→5000ms over 60s on svc-01 and svc-03 (via tc netem, updated every 1s by InfrastructureFaultInjector). Models progressive WAN congestion. Pre-emptive strategies (backpressure, mas-agent) should detect the upward trend via gossip and reroute BEFORE timeout threshold; reactive strategies wait until errors accumulate.
